metricsSection.headline: Impact by the Numbers
metricsSection.description: Measurable results from hands-on IT operations, infrastructure management, and hospitality technology support.

highlights: Oversee end-to-end IT operations for a 4-star hotel, ensuring system availability, business continuity, and seamless technology across every guest touchpoint.
Developed and enforced IT policies, compliance standards, and infrastructure audit frameworks that reduced unplanned downtime by 80%.
Administer Windows Server across physical, VMware, and cloud environments alongside Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, managing 30+ user accounts end-to-end.
Manage the Microsoft 365 tenant — Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Microsoft Defender — maintaining security baselines and compliance policies.
Manage and troubleshoot the hotel's network infrastructure: FortiGate firewalls, HPE Aruba and H3C switching, and wireless access points across 2 floors.
Diagnosed and resolved a network-wide DHCP failure caused by an unplanned power outage, restoring guest and staff connectivity with minimal downtime.
Administer hospitality systems including OPERA PMS Cloud, Oracle MICROS Simphony POS, Avaya IP Telephony, VingCard access control, and LG Pro:Centric IPTV across 180 rooms.
Delivered IT onboarding and systems training to 40+ pre-opening staff, and provide second-line support for desktops, POS terminals, printers, CCTV, and A/V systems.
Implement IT security standards and manage backup and recovery via Arctera Backup Exec; coordinate with ISPs and vendors on procurement, upgrades, and SLAs.
Delivered first-line technical support to 30+ employees, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues.
Installed, configured, and maintained desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals across 4 departments.
Managed user accounts, email configuration, and access permissions via Active Directory and Google Workspace Admin Console.
Created and configured new domains, connected them to Google Workspace, and managed email setup and migration for 30+ users.
Performed network troubleshooting including IP configuration checks and switch and patch panel diagnostics.
Maintained IT asset records and inventory logs, and set up 4 meeting rooms with video conferencing and AV equipment.
